title: Please check out my WIP - Traditional Roguelike Deckbuilder AI Game
author: mannew2026
selftext:
I have been working on my AI game coded using Claude and Codex. The art is primarily from Codex. I have been working on for almost 2 months now. Its far from complete, and this is not a true vertical slice, as the real game will feature more randomized encounters but I think this is a good demo. 

You can play the game here:  
[https://ayiteb.itch.io/dawn-front](https://ayiteb.itch.io/dawn-front)  
password: burke

I would love some feedback. Primarily on the  fun the game is, ease of controls, difficulty and visual presentation. I art directed the heck out of this game but even that piece is incomplete because I ran out of credits. 

I set up a discord in case anyone wanted to chat about the game. Happy to discuss whatever there. [https://discord.gg/yc9FJBfCF](https://discord.gg/yc9FJBfCF)

Hope you enjoy it! And I hope to hear from you!
